warmup.description: Ease into movement with breath-led joint preparation and gentle dynamic mobility.
movements: Supine breathing with rib expansion x 5 breaths
Cat-cow with lateral shift x 6 each side
Arm sweeps on floor x 8 each side

main_exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Flow Transitions
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, move with control through available range
main_exercises.form_cue: Rotate hips smoothly without collapsing the torso forward

main_exercises.name: Spinal Rotation + Reach Flow
main_exercises.form_cue: Follow your hand with your eyes to encourage full rotation

main_exercises.name: Dynamic Hamstring Mobility Sequence
main_exercises.form_cue: Extend leg smoothly while keeping hips grounded

main_exercises.name: Scapular Glide and Shoulder CARs
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, move slowly through full shoulder range
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep neck relaxed and isolate movement to the shoulder joint

main_exercises.name: Low Lunge Mobility Flow
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight only, focus on gentle opening
main_exercises.form_cue: Sink hips forward gradually while keeping torso tall

cooldown.description: Settle the body and integrate mobility gains with slow, grounding stretches.
movements: Deep squat hold with support x 60s
Supine figure 4 stretch x 30s each side
Full body stretch lying down x 60s

phase_notes.menstrual: This session supports gentle release—move slowly and stay within comfortable ranges. Focus on breath to guide mobility without pushing depth.
phase_notes.follicular: You may feel more open and fluid—explore slightly deeper ranges in hips and shoulders while maintaining control.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Take advantage of increased mobility and coordination—move through fuller ranges but avoid overstretching or forcing positions.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Use this session to maintain joint mobility and reduce early tension buildup—focus on smooth, consistent transitions.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Prioritize soft, calming movement—keep everything slow and controlled to reduce tightness and support relaxation.
